purpose: local visual emergent communication stimuli; labels never passed to policy
split_unit: Commons original image; related shots manually checked during selection
selection_notes: 60 manually reviewed photographs: 30 food (10 apple,10 banana,10 orange),30 water in transparent containers.
Training and test use distinct original photographs, not crops of the same image.
8 held-out images per resource class; no text labels, filenames or metadata are policy inputs.
Rejected candidates include empty/ambiguous drinking vessels, legible markings/background text, a swimming image, and visually unclear resources.
Manual visual screening only, not an OCR guarantee; small pilot dataset and limited ecological realism.
